title: 3D-printed dive computer mount
summary: Parametric Fusion 360 replacement for a dive computer strap, using elastic loops to accommodate drysuit compression.
problem: A conventional strap can become loose as a drysuit compresses during descent. A replacement strap assembly was costly.
solution: Designed a hinged attachment to fit the existing computer and 3D-printed a support-free part with loops for elastic straps.
process: Document dimensions and attachment constraints on the existing dive computer
Model a hinge and attachment loops for an elastic bungee-style strap
Orient geometry so it can print without support structures
Prototype and fit the hinged attachment
Attach inexpensive elastic straps through the printed loops
results: Working printed attachment replacing the original strap arrangement
Approximately 11 minutes per print, including setup
Reported total cost: 49 NOK, versus more than 400 NOK for the replacement strap

title: Hull analysis tool
summary: Component-aware 3D model viewer and hydrostatic analysis workspace.
problem: Engineering model viewers and analysis tools are often fragmented.
solution: Use one semantic model for rendering, hydrostatics and future structural/CFD modules.
